methodology: Availability is applied by week to the starter and backup quarterback components. Unlisted teams default to full starter availability.

statusRules.major-knee-recovery-not-cleared: 70% in Week 1, improving by 10 percentage points per week until Week 4, then 100% from Week 5.

KC.note: Patrick Mahomes is rehabilitating the knee injury that ended his 2025 season. Week 1 remains a goal, not a confirmed clearance.
